problem: Two real restricted filesystem tests force the Cargo bwrap executable through their logging/fail-once shim even though product launcher discovery prefers a suitable system binary. Both fail before the original filesystem assertions, at loopback RTM_NEWADDR initialization.

evidence_strength.observed_original_gate: Original full four-package r24 exited 100. The two exact closed failure blocks contain the same loopback error; original assertions and error output are retained.
evidence_strength.observed_authorized_diagnostic: On the recorded unchanged source50 host, the system and repository ELFs were each invoked once with identical existing restricted probe arguments. System exited 0; repository exited 1 with 61-byte stderr whose 60-byte message matches both original errors. Production trims the terminal LF before the quoted capability failure. Version commands, raw rc, output, ELF guards, source/lock guards, and controller natural exit are preserved.
evidence_strength.source_causal_inference: The fixture forced a different launcher-discovery route from the product. Reusing the existing public discovery API before installing the shim restores that selection precedence without altering the sandbox arguments or runtime checks.
evidence_strength.unresolved_lower_level_cause: No actual netlink error payload, credential transition, or LSM decision was traced. Repository network.c can return failure without assigning the netlink errno, so the printed EPERM cannot establish that cause.

change.description: Resolve codex_sandboxing::find_system_bwrap_in_path() in the parent before writing the shim; use existing cargo_bin("bwrap") only when discovery returns None.
change.public_api_and_existing_dependency: The package already has codex-sandboxing; the function is publicly re-exported on Linux, where both affected callers are gated.
change.recursion_boundary: Both affected callers invoke write_fake_bwrap before prepending the fresh shim directory to a child-only PATH. The parent PATH is unchanged and the new shim does not yet exist when discovery runs.
change.discovery_is_not_capability_acceptance: The downstream original product help/capability eligibility checks still inspect the delegated executable. Discovery alone does not assert every system bwrap is supported.
